headline_findings.high: the wheel-description unit spanning Ezek.10.9-10.17 certifies itself on a LEXICAL EXCLUSIVITY THAT IS FALSE ON THE BYTES - the wheel word stands at MT 3:13, MT 10:19 and MT 11:22 and the whirling-wheel word at MT 10:2, MT 23:24 and MT 26:10, so it crosses both adjacent seams; and the unit states in the same breath that no formula marks its onset, leaving it no other affirmative ground
headline_findings.medium: Ezek.9.1-9.11 rejects the rival cut after MT 9:3 on the ground that the addressee never changes through MT 9:11; the addressee is the man in linen at MT 9:4, the six at MT 9:5, them at MT 9:7 and the prophet at MT 9:9. Ezek.8.14-8.18 asserts a paseq at MT 8:14 the record does not carry (ch 8 carries paseq at 8:1, 8:3, 8:6 and 8:10 only) and describes a rival span as stopping on a samekh that falls inside it. Two closes are one verse short of the enclosing Masoretic section without disclosing the nearest positive mark evidence: the samekh after MT 8:14 for the close at MT 8:13, and the pe after MT 11:1 for the close at MT 10:22.
headline_findings.low: a device phrase printed with a preposition MT 1:1 does not carry; and MT 10:4 called the first stage of the glory's exit when MT 9:3 already narrates that movement under a different divine title.
